discovery.title: Fumanisa iimodeli ze-Novera
discovery.estimated: Qikelela kwi-8,192 iithokheni; Ukuhambelana kwe-injini kufuneka kuhlolwe.
discovery.benchmarkNote: Amanqaku abapapashi asebenzisa iindlela ezahlukeneyo; azilinganisi ezi fayile ze-GGUF kwisikali esiqhelekileyo.
discovery.testHint: Khuphela kwaye usebenzise imodeli kuqala. Uvavanyo lwasekhaya: ukuya kuthi ga kwi-128 amathokheni. Ukwenziwa komsebenzi kubandakanya ukukhawuleza; inkumbulo yeyenkqubo yonke.

catalog.title: Phonononga i-AI nge-Novera
catalog.subtitle: Fumanisa iimodeli ngokuzisebenzisa, jonga iimfuno zazo kwaye ukhethe kwihardware yakho.
catalog.preparedNote: Khangela yonke imimandla ye-AI. Eminye imisebenzi ifuna injini ekusafuneka idityaniswe.
catalog.catalogError: Ukufunyanwa okukhoyo akufumaneki. Iimodeli ebezilayishwe ngaphambili zihlala zifikeleleka.
catalog.tight: Inkumbulo elinganiselweyo okanye i-CPU yokubuyela umva
catalog.estimateNote: Uqikelelo lubandakanya ubunzima, umxholo kunye nendawo yokugcina. Ukusebenza, indawo yediski yasimahla kunye nenkxaso yezakhiwo zisafuna ukujongwa.
catalog.pythonNote: Ifuna indawo emiselweyo yePython/PyTorch. Ngenisa ifolda epheleleyo kwii-Safetensors / Transformers. Ukusetyenziswa kwe-GPU kufuna i-CUDA yokwakha.
catalog.metadataMissing: Enye imetadata ayikwazanga kuqinisekiswa. Hlaziya imodeli yomthombo ngaphambi kokukhuphela.
catalog.acknowledge: Ndiluhlolisisile uqikelelo kunye nokuhlolwa kokuhambelana okuseleyo.
catalog.advisorNote: Iingcebiso zibalwa kwindawo ukusuka kwimethadatha kunye noqikelelo lwememori. Ukusebenza kusafuna ukulinganiswa.
catalog.reasonReady: Injini edityanisiweyo kunye nengqikelelo yememori ekhululekile.
catalog.reasonLanguage: Imodeli yolwimi echaziweyo ihambelana nolwimi lwakho lojongano.
catalog.tipLimited: Khetha uhlobo olulula okanye umxholo omfutshane ukushiya inkumbulo eninzi ikhona.
catalog.tipRuntime: Qinisekisa iPython/PyTorch ngaphambi kokuba uthembele kwi-GPU yokukhawulezisa.
catalog.tipFuture: Injini eyongezelelweyo iyafuneka phambi kokuba lo msebenzi usebenze kwi-Novera.
catalog.advisorEmpty: Akukho ndawo ifanelekileyo yokuqalisa inokukhethwa kwimetadata yangoku.
catalog.hardwareUnknown: Ulwazi lwe-Hardware alukho; iingcebiso kufuneka RAM kunye GPU data.
catalog.contextTip: Umxholo omfutshane usebenzisa imemori encinci ngaphandle kokutshintsha ubungakanani bokukhuphela.
catalog.nvfp4Search: I-Blackwell GPU enememori eyaneleyo echazwe ifunyenwe. Khetha iinguqulelo ze-NVFP4 xa ulwakhiwo kunye nenjini zixhasa. I-FLUX.2 ye-Klein 4B ye-Comfy yokulayisha iyafumaneka kwimithombo yendawo; khangela i-CUDA PyTorch, ukuxhomekeka okukhethiweyo, iimodeli ezihambelanayo kunye nememori yasimahla ngaphambi kokukhuphela. Ubhaqo lwe-Hardware aluqinisekisi ixesha lokusebenza elimiselweyo okanye isantya sesiqinisekiso.
catalog.nvfp4Prefer: NVFP4 icetyiswa kule GPU kunye ne-FLUX.2 Klein 4B usapho. Ukulayishwa kwemveli kufuna ulungiselelo oluxhasiweyo lweComfy, CUDA PyTorch kunye nokuxhomekeka okukhethiweyo. Khetha imodeli yomfanekiso, i-encoder ye-Qwen3 kunye ne-VAE ngokwahlukeneyo kwiisetingi zeNdalo. Ixesha lokusebenza, indibaniselwano epheleleyo kunye nememori esimahla isafuna ukuqinisekiswa.
catalog.nvfp4Check: NVFP4 ifunyenwe: I-GPU amandla, imemori yamahhala, ubungakanani bobunzima okanye inkxaso yezakhiwo ayiqinisekiswanga. Jonga i-injini ye-CUDA ngaphambi kokukhetha lo mahluko. Ifomathi iyodwa ayimiseli ukuhambelana.
catalog.nvfp4Unsupported: Native NVFP4 ayikhuthazwa nge-GPU eboniweyo okanye i-VRAM yangoku yasimahla. Qwalasela ehambelanayo GGUF quantization okanye injini ehambelanayo. Loo ndlela ayiboneleli ngokukhawulezisa iFP4.
catalog.quantQualityAdvice: Novera GGUF isikhokelo sombhalo, umfanekiso kunye namacandelo evidiyo: Q6_K okanye ngaphezulu sisindululo sethu sokuqala xa sibeka phambili ukuthembeka; I-Q4_K_M ibhalansisa umgangatho kunye nememori. Ezi zingcebiso, hayi umqobo wokuchaneka jikelele. Iziphumo zixhomekeke kwimodeli kunye nomsebenzi. I-NVFP4 kunye nezinye izikimu zokulinganisa zifuna ukuhambelana kwazo kunye novavanyo lomgangatho.
